');background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #b48d58}

.side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:690px} .studentbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:7px;align-items:center;padding:9px 11px;background:#f4e5c7;border-bottom:1px solid #bea174} .studentname{font-weight:900} .scorebox{font:900 .84rem Arial,sans-serif;color:#62482e;text-align:right} .progress{height:8px;background:#e2d3b5;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;grid-column:1/-1} .progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:#3b78a3;transition:width .4s}

.options{display:grid;gap:7px} .option{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr;gap:9px;align-items:center;min-height:52px;padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid #c8ad7d;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf6;font-size:clamp(.98rem,1.1vw,1.1rem);font-weight:700;text-align:left} .option:hover:not(:disabled){background:#fff6e7;border-color:#8a663d} .option:disabled{cursor:default}
.letter{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:9px;background:#745334;color:#fff;font:900 1.2rem Arial,sans-serif} .option.correct{background:#dff0e4;border-color:#3d8a57} .option.correct .letter{background:var(--good)} .option.wrong{background:#f5dddd;border-color:#ba5b53} .option.wrong .letter{background:var(--bad)} .option.muted{opacity:.55}
.feedback{display:none;margin-top:9px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;font:900 .96rem/1.35 Arial,sans-serif} .feedback.show{display:block} .feedback.good{background:#e1f1e6;border-left:5px solid var(--good);color:#275d38} .feedback.bad{background:#f6e2df;border-left:5px solid var(--bad);color:#7e302a}
.controls{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px} .stats{padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid #bea174;background:#fbf2df;font:800 .84rem Arial,sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;text-align:center} .stat{padding:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #d0b98f} .stat b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;color:#513b27} .notice{margin:10px 12px 12px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px dashed #b59365;border-radius:10px;background:#f5ead5;font:700 .8rem/1.35 Arial,sans-serif;color:#644e37}
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(42,25,10,.72);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;z-index:50} .card{width:min(640px,96vw);background:var(--paper);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.38);padding:20px} .card h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.9rem} .card p{margin:0 0 15px;color:#685139}
.formgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px} .field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px} .field.full{grid-column:1/-1} .field label{font:900 .82rem Arial,sans-serif;color:#5b432c} .field input{padding:11px 12px;border:2px solid #c5a676;border-radius:10px;background:#fffdf7} .startActions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;background:rgba(42,25,10,.68);z-index:60} .modal.show{display:flex} .report{width:min(760px,96vw);background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);overflow:hidden} .reportHead{background:linear-gradient(#f8e8c8,#ead0a0);padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:2px solid #b68b52;text-align:center} .reportHead h2{margin:0} .reportBody{padding:18px} .reportGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px} .reportItem{border:1px solid #cdb182;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;background:#fffaf1} .reportItem small{display:block;color:#755b3c;font:800 .72rem Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase} .reportItem strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:1.05rem} .grade{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:15px;border:2px solid #9b7441;border-radius:12px;background:#f6ead2;margin-top:4px} .grade .num{font:900 3rem/1 Arial,sans-serif;color:#2f6842} .formula{margin-top:10px;padding:9px;border-radius:9px;background:#f2f2f2;font:700 .82rem/1.35 Arial,sans-serif;color:#555} .reportActions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:0 18px 18px} .hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:1050px){.main{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side{min-height:auto}} @media(max-width:620px){.formgrid,.reportGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.field.full,.grade{grid-column:auto}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media print{body{background:#fff} body *{visibility:hidden!important} #reportModal,#reportModal *{visibility:visible!important} #reportModal{position:static!important;display:block!important;background:#fff!important;padding:0!important} .report{width:100%!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important} .reportActions{display:none!important}}

<body>
<div class="app">
<div class="header"><div><h1>⛵ Rota das Grandes Navegações</h1><p>Jogo individual • História — 2º Ano • Expansão Marítima</p></div><button class="btn bad" id="resetBtn">↻ Novo aluno</button></div>
<div class="main">
<section class="panel"><div class="maphead"><strong>De Portugal às Índias — 15 casas</strong><span class="legend">acerto +1 • erro −1</span></div><div class="mapwrap"><div class="map" id="map">
<div class="navigatorName" id="navigatorNameUnique" style="left:51.1%;width:24%"></div>
<div class="token" id="token"><div class="ship">⛵</div><div class="tokenLabel" id="tokenLabel">Jogador</div></div></div></div></section>
<aside class="panel side">
<div class="studentbar"><div class="studentname" id="studentDisplay">Aluno</div><div class="scorebox"><span id="posDisplay">0</span>/15 casas</div><div class="progress"><i id="progressBar"></i></div></div>
<div class="qa">
<div class="meta"><span class="round" id="roundInfo">Questões: 0/60</span><span class="tag" id="sourceTag">Aguardando início</span></div>
<div class="question" id="questionText">Preencha seus dados para iniciar.</div><div class="options" id="options"></div><div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>
<div class="controls"><button class="btn gold" id="drawBtn" disabled>🎲 Sortear pergunta</button><button class="btn good hidden" id="nextBtn">➡ Próxima pergunta</button></div>
</div>
<div class="stats"><div class="stat">Acertos<b id="correctStat">0</b></div><div class="stat">Erros<b id="errorStat">0</b></div><div class="stat">Nota atual*<b id="gradeStat">20,00</b></div></div>
<div class="notice">* Nota máxima: <b>20 pontos</b>. Para obter 20, o aluno deve chegar à casa 15 sem erro. Cada erro desconta <b>1/15 da nota máxima</b>, ou seja, aproximadamente <b>1,33 ponto</b>, até o mínimo de zero.</div>
</aside>
</div></div>

<div class="overlay" id="startOverlay"><div class="card"><h2>Rota das Grandes Navegações</h2><p>Preencha os dados. As 60 questões são embaralhadas e não se repetem.</p>
<div class="formgrid">
<div class="field full"><label>NOME DO ALUNO</label><input id="nameInput" placeholder="Digite seu nome"></div>
<div class="field full"><label>ESCOLA</label><input id="schoolInput" placeholder="Nome da escola"></div>
<div class="field"><label>TURMA</label><input id="classInput" placeholder="Ex.: A"></div>
<div class="field"><label>SÉRIE / ANO</label><input id="seriesInput" placeholder="Ex.: 2º Ano"></div>
</div><div class="startActions"><button class="btn good" id="startBtn">⚓ Iniciar jogo</button></div></div></div>

<div class="modal" id="reportModal"><div class="report"><div class="reportHead"><h2>RELATÓRIO FINAL — EXPANSÃO MARÍTIMA</h2></div><div class="reportBody">
<div class="reportGrid">
<div class="reportItem"><small>Nome</small><strong id="rName"></strong></div><div class="reportItem"><small>Escola</small><strong id="rSchool"></strong></div>
<div class="reportItem"><small>Turma</small><strong id="rClass"></strong></div><div class="reportItem"><small>Série / Ano</small><strong id="rSeries"></strong></div>
<div class="reportItem"><small>Número de erros</small><strong id="rErrors"></strong></div><div class="reportItem"><small>Questões respondidas</small><strong id="rQuestions"></strong></div>
<div class="grade"><div>NOTA FINAL</div><div class="num" id="rGrade"></div><div>de 20 pontos</div></div>
</div><div class="formula" id="rFormula"></div></div>
<div class="reportActions"><button class="btn gold" onclick="window.print()">🖨 Imprimir / Salvar PDF</button><button class="btn secondary" id="closeReportBtn">Fechar</button><button class="btn bad" id="newStudentBtn">↻ Novo aluno</button></div>
</div></div>

"Camponeses", "Burguesia", "Servos"]}];
const ROUTE=[[30.0,23.5],[31.7,26.2],[27.4,33.9],[25.2,42.1],[28.4,50.5],[34.3,67.4],[40.0,72.7],[46.7,73.2],[54.1,72.8],[63.1,67.2],[67.8,59.4],[70.3,50.6],[74.8,43.6],[85.0,38.8],[92.4,37.1],[89.8,34.8]];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let student={name:'',school:'',className:'',series:''},deck=[],deckPos=0,position=0,errors=0,correct=0,answered=0,current=null,order=[],locked=false,finished=false;

function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function gradeValue(){return Math.max(0,20-errors*(20/15))}
function gradeText(){return gradeValue().toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}
function updateHUD(){
 $('studentDisplay').textContent=student.name?`${student.name} — ${student.className} / ${student.series}`:'Aluno';
 $('tokenLabel').textContent=student.name||'Jogador';
 {
   const el=document.getElementById('navigatorNameUnique');
   if(el){
     el.textContent=student.name||'';
     const n=(student.name||'').length;
     el.style.fontSize = n>24 ? '8px' : n>18 ? '9px' : n>12 ? '10px' : '';
   }
 }
 $('posDisplay').textContent=position; $('progressBar').style.width=(position/15*100)+'%';
 $('correctStat').textContent=correct; $('errorStat').textContent=errors; $('gradeStat').textContent=gradeText(); $('roundInfo').textContent=`Questões: ${answered}/60`;
 const p=ROUTE[position]; $('token').style.left=p[0]+'%'; $('token').style.top=p[1]+'%';
}
function startGame(){
 const name=$('nameInput').value.trim(),school=$('schoolInput').value.trim(),cls=$('classInput').value.trim(),series=$('seriesInput').value.trim();
 if(!name||!school||!cls||!series){alert('Preencha nome, escola, turma e série/ano.');return}
 student={name,school,className:cls,series}; deck=shuffle([...Array(QUESTIONS.length).keys()]); deckPos=0;position=0;errors=0;correct=0;answered=0;finished=false;locked=false;
 $('startOverlay').classList.add('hidden'); $('drawBtn').disabled=false; $('questionText').textContent='Clique em “Sortear pergunta” para começar.'; $('sourceTag').textContent='Pronto para jogar'; updateHUD();
}
function drawQuestion(){
 if(finished||locked)return; if(deckPos>=deck.length){finish(false);return}
 current=QUESTIONS[deck[deckPos++]]; order=shuffle([0,1,2,3]); locked=false; $('questionText').textContent=current.q; $('sourceTag').textContent=current.c; $('feedback').className='feedback'; $('feedback').textContent=''; $('drawBtn').classList.add('hidden'); $('nextBtn').classList.add('hidden'); renderOptions();
}
function renderOptions(){
 const w=$('options');w.innerHTML=''; order.forEach((srcIdx,dispIdx)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='option';b.dataset.src=srcIdx;b.innerHTML=`<span class="letter">${'ABCD'[dispIdx]}</span><span>${current.options[srcIdx]}</span>`;b.onclick=()=>answer(srcIdx,b);w.appendChild(b)})
}
function answer(srcIdx,clicked){
 if(locked||finished)return; locked=true;answered++; const chosen=current.options[srcIdx],ok=chosen===current.a; const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.option')];
 btns.forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;const txt=current.options[+b.dataset.src];if(txt===current.a)b.classList.add('correct');else if(b===clicked)b.classList.add('wrong');else b.classList.add('muted')});
 const fb=$('feedback');
 if(ok){correct++;position=Math.min(15,position+1);fb.className='feedback show good';fb.textContent='✅ Resposta correta! Seu navio avançou 1 casa.'}
 else{errors++;position=Math.max(0,position-1);fb.className='feedback show bad';fb.textContent=`❌ Resposta incorreta. Correta: ${current.a}. Seu navio voltou 1 casa.`}
 updateHUD();
 if(position>=15)setTimeout(()=>finish(true),600); else{ $('nextBtn').textContent=deckPos>=deck.length?'📄 Encerrar e gerar relatório':'➡ Próxima pergunta'; $('nextBtn').classList.remove('hidden'); }
}
function nextQuestion(){if(finished)return;if(deckPos>=deck.length){finish(false);return}locked=false;current=null;$('options').innerHTML='';$('feedback').className='feedback';$('questionText').textContent='Pronto para a próxima questão.';$('sourceTag').textContent='Sorteio sem repetição';$('nextBtn').classList.add('hidden');$('drawBtn').classList.remove('hidden')}
function finish(completed){
 if(finished)return;finished=true;
 $('rName').textContent=student.name;$('rSchool').textContent=student.school;$('rClass').textContent=student.className;$('rSeries').textContent=student.series;$('rErrors').textContent=errors;$('rQuestions').textContent=answered;$('rGrade').textContent=gradeText();
 const dec=(20/15).toFixed(2).replace('.',','); $('rFormula').textContent=(completed?'Percurso concluído nas 15 casas. ':'Banco de 60 questões encerrado antes da casa 15. ')+`Cálculo: 20,00 − (${errors} erro(s) × ${dec}) = ${gradeText()}.`;
 $('reportModal').classList.add('show');
}
function resetAll(){location.reload()}
$('startBtn').onclick=startGame;$('drawBtn').onclick=drawQuestion;$('nextBtn').onclick=nextQuestion;$('resetBtn').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Iniciar para um novo aluno?'))resetAll()};$('newStudentBtn').onclick=resetAll;$('closeReportBtn').onclick=()=>$('reportModal').classList.remove('show');updateHUD();
</script>
</body>
</html>
